heroHeadline: Tinubu Wins APC 2027 Ticket with 10.9M Votes on Democracy Day Anniversary; Q1 GDP Growth at 3.89%
heroSubtitle: President Tinubu secures APC presidential primary with ~10.9 million votes (May 23), receives Certificate of Return (May 24), and marks his 3rd anniversary in office on May 29's Democracy Day; NBS reports Q1 2026 real GDP growth of 3.89%, with non-oil sector driving 96% of output; Nigerian Army reports 317 terrorists killed and 221 civilians rescued in May operations; civil society presses EFCC to disclose Betta Edu corruption case outcome
footerNote: Data sourced from official Nigerian government records, major international outlets, and institutional analyses. Casualty figures are contested and drawn from multiple independent sources.
